arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Freeman argued bankruptcy estates incur taxes when they generate income.
Mr. Shah argued postpetition tax liabilities are not subject to discharge.
Justice Kennedy asked about debts incurred after the filing date.
Justice Sotomayor noted the debtor is going to pay.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case examines who owes income taxes created after a bankruptcy filing. the sides that brought the case argue the estate should pay. The government argues the debtor must pay. The Court seeks clarity on this financial responsibility.
